description: This file defines the Coverage class, which implements code coverage functionalities related to JavaScript and CSS on a webpage. It manages starting and stopping coverage collection through a channel interface.

classes.name: Coverage
classes.description: Implements methods to control JavaScript and CSS code coverage collection on a webpage.

methods.name: constructor
methods.description: Initializes the Coverage instance with a PageChannel.

methods.name: startJSCoverage
methods.description: Begins JavaScript code coverage collection with optional parameters.

methods.name: stopJSCoverage
methods.description: Stops JavaScript coverage collection and returns the coverage entries.

methods.name: startCSSCoverage
methods.description: Begins CSS coverage collection with optional parameters.

methods.name: stopCSSCoverage
methods.description: Stops CSS coverage collection and returns the coverage entries.
